I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
If you’re watching your budget, we’ve got a few wallet‑friendly ways to shop:
Spread payments with Klarna (on orders over £60):
Pay in 3 equal instalments (at checkout, then 30 and 60 days later).
Or Pay in 30 days in one go—both options are interest‑free when paid on time.
Use standard card/wallet payments so you stay in control of what you spend:
Cards via Shop Pay: Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Diners Club, Discover, Maestro, Union Pay (Japan only).
Wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay.
Local methods if you’re eligible: Bancontact (Belgium) and iDeal (Netherlands).
Gift cards can also be a neat way to pre‑set your budget:
Available in £10, £25, £50, £100 amounts and they don’t expire, so you can buy once and redeem whenever.
If you’re looking at co‑branded/bulk orders, your budget planning should factor in:
Minimum order 30 units per size & color (90 for full wrap, higher for bespoke).
Delivery included in the unit cost for UK, EU, Switzerland.
Other countries pay extra shipping and may face customs/duty & local VAT.
So, for a “sensible budget,” Klarna helps spread the cost, gift cards cap your spend, and knowing MOQs and shipping rules avoids nasty surprises at checkout.
